name: npm Registry & Downloads API
summary: Package metadata, versions, dist-tags and search for every package on npm.
description: Public read-only CouchDB-style registry exposing package manifests (versions, dependencies, maintainers, tarball URLs, integrity hashes) and a search endpoint that also returns weekly/monthly download counts. A companion host api.npmjs.org returns download statistics by package and date range.

rate_limit.summary: No published hard numbers; fair-use throttling (HTTP 429). Downloads API has range limits (18 months per query).

license.name: Package metadata varies per package; registry ToS

agent_notes: Fetch /{package}/latest for a small manifest instead of the full packument. For download counts use the separate api.npmjs.org host, and send a User-Agent.
caveats: Full packuments can be many MB; use /{pkg}/latest or abbreviated header 'Accept: application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json'.
